theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_cp_prod_rectangle_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), Module.finrank ℝ V = n → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → ∃ σ : Measure (Euclid P), σ (Vᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → σ K < ∞) ∧ ∀ A B : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → ν (V.starProjection ⁻¹' A ∩ Vᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' B) = σ B * μHE[n] (A ∩ (V : Set (Euclid P)))
